THE ANALYSIS FRAMEWORK

Strategy library.

Transparent heuristics. Understand every signal.

This tool identifies price patterns; it does not predict certainty. Swings require two closed candles on each side. Signals describe the latest 20 candles unless stated. Entry uses the nearest active zone in the directional bias; stop sits beyond its edge and the latest swing with a 0.25 ATR buffer. Targets are 1R and 2R. A setup needs at least three aligned factors and must remain within 2 ATR of entry; otherwise it is marked Wait. The model is not backtested or calibrated. Sample results are illustrative.

Market data schema: Binance Futures Kline API. Data availability depends on exchange and regional restrictions.
